conventions.FIML: Raw-data normal likelihood; chi-square is the likelihood ratio to the unrestricted H1 model. SRMR uses lavaan's unrestricted H1 EM covariance on the same incomplete sample (default EM settings recorded). For d_obs, the variance of the unit-weighted mean of k factor items is sum(S_H1)/k^2, using the unrestricted H1 EM covariance on the full multigroup sample and multiplying by n_g/(n_g-1) for the specified sample-SD divisor. This is the missing-data covariance convention; individual missing responses are not filled in.
